result.summary: Found 1 issue: a restaurant card in the 'Popular right now' section shows a broken image placeholder instead of its photo.

issues.description: The first card under 'Popular right now' (Tokumaru Ramen Bar) displays a gray box with a broken-image icon instead of the restaurant photo, while the delivery badge and heart icon still render over it.
issues.suggestion: Ensure the restaurant image URL loads correctly and provide a proper fallback image so the card does not show a broken placeholder.
